road.title: Saying hello
road.description: A long-limbed figure who has clearly been assembled in a hurry in a coat with more pockets than the law requires, carrying a bag that clinks in an administrative way. Bartholomew is a Census Taker and has been counting the people on this road since before it was a road and is missing exactly one.

character.name: Bartholomew Tuffet
character.description: A long-limbed figure who has clearly been assembled in a hurry in a coat with more pockets than the law requires, carrying a bag that clinks in an administrative way. Bartholomew is a Census Taker and has been counting the people on this road since before it was a road and is missing exactly one.

npc.narrative: You reach the Stubborn Copse on a clear mattina, under a bright cielo, where the alberi stand about like men told to wait. Bartholomew Tuffet sits at a small tavolo with a grande libro, one penna and an empty sedia, counting the gente on the strada. The total is one short, sempre.
npc.native: Buongiorno! Io sono Bartholomew Tuffet, e conto le persone su questa strada. Di solito dico «ciao» a tutti, «come va?» agli amici e «a presto» alla fine. Manca sempre una persona, ma io continuo. Tu chi sei, e che cosa pensi del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: Good morning! I am Bartholomew Tuffet, and I count the people on this road. Usually I say "hello" to everyone, "how is it going?" to friends and "see you soon" at the end. One person is always missing, but I carry on. Who are you, and what do you think of my work?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely start! You greeted Bartholomew and told him your name in correct Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: You greeted Bartholomew in Italian, well done.
You didn't ask Bartholomew how he is yet. Try asking him in Italian, and he will give you another chance to do it.
You haven't said goodbye to Bartholomew yet. That will come up again later, when it's time to part.

openObjectives.prompt: Bartholomew looks like someone with a great deal to report on the subject of how they are. Ask Bartholomew how they are, using Italian.
Bartholomew has other people to be greeted by. Say goodbye to Bartholomew, using Italian.

npc.narrative: You stand on the strada while Bartholomew writes «Tom» in a small quaderno, pressing hard, as though names might otherwise wander off. The mattina is clear, and the road, he is fairly sure, is exactly where he left it. He looks at you the way an uomo looks at a number that has finally turned up.
npc.native: Piacere, Tom! Io conto le persone su questa strada, e a tutti chiedo «come stai?». Qualche volta chiedo anche «come va?», perché il mio lavoro è molto lungo. Tu da dove vieni, e che cosa fai qui questa mattina?
npc.translation: Pleased to meet you, Tom! I count the people on this road, and I ask everyone "how are you?". Sometimes I also ask "how is it going?", because my job is very long. Where do you come from, and what are you doing here this morning?

correction.translation: Uh... I don't understand. How are you?

verdict.overallFeedback: Nice work: you asked Bartholomew how he is in Italian, and you told him honestly that you didn't understand. Keep going, you're doing well!

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you asked Bartholomew how he is with "Come stai?".
You haven't said goodbye to Bartholomew yet; that is wanted next, so he will give you another chance to do it later.

correction.translation: Uh... I don't understand. How are you?

openObjectives.prompt: Bartholomew has other people to be greeted by. Say goodbye to Bartholomew, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Bartholomew lowers his penna and gives you the look of a uomo whose numero has finally come out right. The strada behind him is quiet, the way a strada is quiet after la notte. Il cielo is clear, and his foglio is already quite pieno.
npc.native: Io sto bene, grazie, Tom, e non importa: io parlo piano. Ora devo contare fino al ponte, quindi a dopo! Di solito dico «arrivederci» a chi non torna. Che cosa fai oggi, e che cosa pensi della strada?
npc.translation: I am well, thank you, Tom, and it doesn't matter: I speak slowly. Now I must count as far as the bridge, so see you later! I usually say "goodbye" to those who don't come back. What are you doing today, and what do you think of the road?

verdict.overallFeedback: Well done, Tom! You answered \"Bene!\" and said a clear, natural goodbye to Bartholomew.

objectiveResults.feedback: You said goodbye to Bartholomew in Italian with "Arrivederci", which is correct.

npc.narrative: Bartholomew lowers his penna and regards you as one regards a correct totale. The sole is already warm on the strada, and somewhere past the ponte one persona is, as usual, absent from his quaderno. He taps the page twice, firmly.
npc.native: Bene, Tom! Hai detto «arrivederci» come una persona gentile. Ora io conto fino al ponte, quindi ciao e a presto! Che cosa pensi del mio lavoro, e chi speri di incontrare oggi?
npc.translation: Good, Tom! You said "goodbye" like a polite person. Now I count as far as the bridge, so bye and see you soon! What do you think of my work, and whom do you hope to meet today?

npc.narrative: Il sole is high over the strada, and Bartholomew writes in his grande libro with a very small matita. He looks up, pleased that someone has mentioned the lavoro. Behind him, a pietra waits for its reassessment, un po' offended.
npc.native: Sì, Tom, il lavoro va bene, grazie! Conto tutte le persone, ma ne manca sempre una. Se vuoi, puoi chiedere qualcosa sul mio lavoro o sulla strada. Che cosa fai tu di solito la mattina, e che cosa pensi di questo posto?
npc.translation: Yes, Tom, the work is going well, thank you! I count all the people, but one is always missing. If you like, you can ask something about my work or the road. What do you usually do in the morning, and what do you think of this place?

npc.narrative: Il sole is already over the strada, and Bartholomew sits on a sgabello with his quaderno open on one knee. He looks at you as a man looks at a column of figures that has come out one short, again. Beyond the ponte, a pietra waits to be counted.
npc.native: Buongiorno, Tom! Prego, prego. Tu dici «arrivederci», ma io non ho ancora finito di contare. Che cosa mangi di solito la mattina, e che cosa vuoi sapere sul mio lavoro?
npc.translation: Good morning, Tom! You're welcome, you're welcome. You say "goodbye", but I have not finished counting yet. What do you usually eat in the morning, and what do you want to know about my work?
